moments.text: Night infrared view, dark with faint grey clouds; a bright elongated white shape with small bumps on top sits in a box at the crosshair.
A second small light enters at the upper right and crosses above the crosshair, leaving at the left edge.
The box drops away; the bright shape slides off to the right and is gone as the sensor swings left.
Two small lights side by side appear left of the crosshair; the view zooms in and they sit to its right, then drift back.
The pair stays just left of the crosshair as the view widens; a faint pale streak runs across the upper left.
Contrast switches: the background turns light grey, briefly black, then light grey again; a long pale streak stretches left of the pair.
The sensor zooms in: the pair shows as two round bright spots side by side left of the crosshair, then the zoom snaps back out.
Another short zoom-in shows the two round bright spots again, upper left of the crosshair.
A white flash and black frames, then smeared grey cloud shapes as the sensor changes setting; the pair is faint by the crosshair.
The normal view returns: the two small lights sit left of the crosshair to the end, with a pale streak at upper left.
